bridge.masterSwitch: Allow AI agents to connect to running desktop app
bridge.masterSwitchDesc: When enabled, MCP agents connect to the active canvas over a secure local pipe. Changes appear live with instant single-step Undo.
bridge.injectionWarning: Prompt Injection Defense: User-authored text (table names, column comments, notes) is passed as raw data. Never store confidential credentials or secrets in database schema comments.
bridge.securityNotice: Prompt Injection Defense: User-authored text (table names, column comments, notes) is passed to AI agents strictly as raw data. Never store sensitive credentials or confidential API keys in schema comments.
bridge.listeningTooltip: AI Bridge listening for local connections
bridge.activityDesc: Real-time audit log of tool calls and schema modifications received over the local named pipe.
bridge.noActivityYet: No bridge activity recorded in this session.
bridge.consentDesc: A local AI tool or MCP client is requesting access to your active database canvas.
bridge.consentPromptText: Do you want to allow this agent to read and design tables directly on your active canvas for this session?
